summary: Forest Service tower in Truchas town, built 1922; later a 40-ft wind tower the Martinez family used; by 2015 it lay on the ground in a pasture.

facts.design: 40-foot steel tripod wind tower, used as the lookout from the early 1930s; the design of the 1922 Forest tower is not described
facts.status_note: The wind tower lay on the ground in a private pasture in 2015, per the 2017 report. The report says the original 1922 tower may have been taken down when the wind tower went up.

staffing.status: per diem guard listed in fire plans 1940 to 1955; the tower was no longer used to spot fires by the late 1960s

access.note: The tower lies in a pasture belonging to friends of the Martinez family in Truchas, not the Forest. No source describes public access to the site.

facts.agency: USDA Forest Service, Santa Fe National Forest

events.note: Forest built a lookout tower in the town of Truchas, the only tower it built in a town.
Inspector Aldo Leopold praised the Tesuque Ranger for the tower, with volunteer detection by Manuel Martinez.
Lightning protection added to the tower.
Fire plans from 1940 through 1955 list a per diem guard as the Truchas lookout during high fire danger.
Gilbert Martinez took over as storekeeper and fire warden. By the late 1960s the tower was no longer used for spotting fires.
Gilbert's son gave the tower to friends in Truchas. In 2015 it lay on the ground in their pasture.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1922 Forest tower and the 40-foot wind tower the Martinez family used as a lookout are different structures. The report says the family may have taken the original down when the wind tower went up, but it has no photograph of the 1922 tower. The story states that the record is uncertain.

notes_for_editor: Single agency history (2017) with interview material, plus the FFLA list for the gone status. The 1922 tower's fate is unknown. The 2015 wind tower is the object the photo shows on the ground. The early 1970s abandonment has no exact year, so no event is recorded for it. The record's coordinates put the site in Truchas town. Site is private and the story does not encourage visiting it.
